audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side gave Gwen levels 1 and 6 and marked level 2 even, contradicting whys[0], whys[1] and whys[4].
audit.why: Decisive Strike's silence cancels Snip Snip! mid-cast and Garen's passive regen erases the chip Gwen lands, so levels 1-5 are all his; at 6 Hallowed Mist answers the Q engage but Demacian Justice answers back, which is the definition of even.
audit.corrected: Garen / Garen / Garen / Garen / Skill / Gwen / Gwen.
sources: existing whys[0], whys[1], whys[4], whys[5] prose

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] tells you to Snip 'only when his Decisive Strike silence and Courage are down' without giving either cooldown.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a flat 8s and Courage 22/19.5/17/14.5/12, against your 6.5s Snip Snip! at rank 1. An 8-second silence against a 6.5-second Q means you get one free cast per rotation if you count - that is the whole early game, and the page left it unquantified.
audit.corrected: early, wants.you[0] and whys[2] now carry the numbers; mid names the 120s Demacian Justice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decisive Strike's auto-attack reset is never mentioned.
audit.why: Decisive Strike carries autoReset alongside silence and slow, so the attack wind-up rather than the spell cast is the moment the silence lands. Since the silence is what cancels Snip Snip! mid-cast, reading the reset instead of the cast is what buys you the cast.
audit.corrected: early and wants.foe[0] now name the reset as the tell.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are his, plainly. Garen's Decisive Strike (Q) silences your Snip Snip mid-cast and tacks on an empowered crit, and you have no Hallowed Mist yet to make any of his commitment whiff — so don't walk into auto range to throw a Q he can just silence-and-crit through. Last-hit at the tip of your cone Q, accept the chip, and never E-dash in to trade: there's no champion to hit for the cooldown refund early, his short Q-W combo out-stats you, and he just walks away on his passive regen. The one upside is he can't kill you outright if you never feed him a free silence window.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his, plainly. Decisive Strike (Q) is a flat 8s that silences your Snip Snip! mid-cast and comes out as an auto-attack reset, so the swing wind-up — not the cast — is your tell, and you have no Hallowed Mist yet to make any of it whiff. Last-hit at the tip of your cone Q, accept the chip, and never E-dash in to trade: there is no champion to hit for the cooldown refund early, his short Q-W combo out-stats you, and he walks away on passive regen. The upside is he cannot kill you outright if you never feed him a free silence window.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still his — a melee with no untargetability against a bruiser who out-stats you pre-mist and regens any chip you land. At 6 it finally evens out: drop Hallowed Mist as he flickers in for the Q so his empowered strike and silence eat the fog, slow him with Needlework, and let your heal-on-damage out-sustain his trade inside the cloud. But respect his ult — Demacian Justice is missing-HP true damage, so the moment you dip low his execute deletes you regardless of mist or armor. Bait his Courage (W) before you commit your real Snip so it isn't cutting your full %-HP combo.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still his — a melee with no untargetability against a bruiser who out-stats you pre-mist and regens any chip you land. At 6 it finally evens out: drop Hallowed Mist as he flickers in for the Q so his empowered strike and silence eat the fog, slow him with Needlework, and let your heal-on-damage out-sustain his trade inside the cloud. But respect his ult — Demacian Justice is missing-HP true damage on 120s at rank 1, so the moment you dip low his execute deletes you regardless of mist or armour. Bait his 22s Courage (W) before you commit your real Snip.

edits.before: This is where you take the lane back. Your %-max-HP magic Snip plus the center snip's true damage ignore his armor entirely, and Courage (W) only shaves burst — it does nothing against your sustained on-hit DPS once Riftmaker and an attack-speed item come online. Stand in your mist, use E's range and reset to stay glued to him, and grind his big HP bar down faster than he can spin (Thousand Cuts loves his health stacking). Just keep your HP topped: a careless trade still hands him a Demacian Justice execute, the one button that beats you all game.

notes: Ability names are right here and the prose is second-person. Fixes: (1) the chart gave Gwen level 1 and level 6 and called level 2 even, while whys[0], whys[1] and whys[4] say Garen owns 1 and 2 and that 6 is dead even. Set to Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Skill/Gwen/Gwen. I deliberately did NOT take the packet's Garen-at-6 and Skill-at-first-item, because whys[4] says 'dead even' at 6 and whys[5] plus spikes[2] both say the Riftmaker/Nashor's spike out-trades his Q-W combo. (2) Decisive Strike is an auto-attack reset as well as a silence and the page never says so - the reset wind-up is the tell that the silence is landing, which is the single most important read in this lane because the silence is what cancels Snip Snip! mid-cast. (3) No cooldowns anywhere: Decisive Strike 8s flat, Courage 22s at rank 1, Demacian Justice 120s. DATA DISCREPANCY worth checking: MC_WR_TABLES.gwen.garen reads 42.82 while the packet reports 45.72 for the same matchup over 1003 games. I did not touch either (MC_WR_TABLES is off-limits), but they should not disagree.
